reference_sql:
SELECT order_line_id, net_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * (net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur) / net_revenue_eur, 1) AS margin_pct
FROM sales
WHERE order_line_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
alternatives: SELECT order_line_id, net_revenue_eur, ROUND((net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur) * 100 / net_revenue_eur, 1) AS margin_pct FROM sales WHERE order_line_id >= 1 AND order_line_id <= 20
SELECT order_line_id, net_revenue_eur, ROUND(100 * (1 - units * unit_cost_eur / net_revenue_eur), 1) AS margin_pct FROM sales WHERE order_line_id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
